title: Ken Krawchuk
intro:
Ken Krawchuk (Libertarian Party) is running for election for Governor of Pennsylvania. He is on the ballot on a joint ticket with John Thomas in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Krawchuk completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
